A series of destructive and seemingly endless '''wars''' were fought<ref name="Prom" /> intermittently among the tribes<ref name="Fact File" /> of the native [[Culroon]] of<ref name="Prom" /> the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="TEA-OC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Culroon III/Legends|Culroon III]]<ref name="Prom" /> over many [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] prior to the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]]. The conflicts prevented the Culroon from advancing technologically to the point of achieving [[Realspace/Legends|space]] travel, and caused the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to avoid engaging with the planet. Offworld trade eventually introduced advanced [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] to the planet, which the warlike Culroon were eager to use.<ref name="Fact File" />

A Culroon [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] named [[Kloff]] eventually gained the upper hand in the wars,<ref name="Fact File" /> ending them by using imported weapons to unite the planet under his control<ref name="Prom" /> by [[9 BBY/Legends|9 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> At some point following the Republic's [[Declaration of a New Order|transformation]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="Prom" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] ordered Culroon III to be occupied,<ref name="Prom" /> which included the construction of a [[Imperial garrison (Culroon III)|garrison]] in Kloff's territory.<ref name="Fact File" /> Kloff later mounted an [[Insurrection on Culroon III|insurrection]] against the Empire but was defeated.<ref name="Prom" />

==Behind the scenes==
The wars on Culroon III were first mentioned in the short story "[[The Promotion of Lieutenant Veers]]," published in [[1987]]'s ''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]'' written by [[Bill Slavicsek]] and [[Curtis Smith]].<ref name="Prom" />
